messages:
Jesse (oncall): noticed controller-manager leader churn in eu-west1 ~12:00 UTC, correlating with peering flaps. etcd txn latency spikes and the reserved GPU autoscaler started overshooting replicas :grimacing:
Olivia (SRE): saw the alerts. stackdriver shows etcd write lat >500ms for bursts. do we have leader election logs?
Arnav (k8s): posting snippet from controller-manager logs:
```
I0212 11:59:58.123456 1 leaderelection.go:243] successfully acquired lease redwood/controllermanager-lock
I0212 12:00:03.654321 1 leaderelection.go:305] lost lease redwood/controllermanager-lock
I0212 12:00:04.987654 1 leaderelection.go:243] successfully acquired lease redwood/controllermanager-lock
```
Arnav (k8s): pattern looks like 3-5s reacquires, multiple controllers stepping down -> cascade of reconcile restarts.
Anya (Infra): peering team reported BGP session flap at 11:59:30-12:02; routes oscillated for a subset of eu-west1 nodes.
Jesse (oncall): autoscaler overshot GPU reserved pool by ~20% — we saw 12 -> 15 -> 18 replicas across two clusters in quick succession. costy.
Maya (DevEx): can we stop autoscale until controlplane is stable?
Olivia (SRE): yes; short mitigation: pause autoscaling and manually scale down to expected baseline. also keep watching leader-election metrics.
Jesse (oncall): ran commands to pause and downscale:
```
# internal-tool rscale --pool eu-west1-gpu-reserved --action pause-autoscale
# internal-tool rscale --pool eu-west1-gpu-reserved --replicas 12 --reason "controlplane instability"
```
DeployBot: autoscaler paused for eu-west1-gpu-reserved by Jesse (oncall) at 12:06 UTC :white_check_mark:
Arnav (k8s): etcd metrics show WAL fsync bucket spike >1s around 12:00. etcd commit latency aligns with the BGP flap window.
Anya (Infra): peering team applied a fix and BFD alerts will be added for that exchange. reroute converged by 12:05 UTC.
Olivia (SRE): next steps: create alert that cross-checks leader-election churn with etcd_commit_latency >200ms AND autoscaler scaling actions >2 in 5m to prevent blind overscale during controlplane events. update runbook to include pause-autoscale step and who to page (peering + k8s).
Arnav (k8s): propose config changes: increase leader lease from 15s -> 30s, renewDeadline 10s, and add jitter/backoff to election logic. I'll open a PR for controller-manager flags.
Maya (DevEx): cost impact note: overshoot estimated ~ $1.8k for the 6-minute window. filing a short incident note for finance.
Jesse (oncall): also recommend a temporary suppression rule in autoscaler to ignore spikes when controlplane health degrades. will draft RFC.
Olivia (SRE): agree on suppression + longer leases. After PR lands we should test in staging with induced ETCD latency.
Maya (DevEx): thanks — keeping thread for postmortem notes. :pray:
